sourceTitle: Microcosmography or, a Piece of the World Discovered; in Essays and Characters
description: "Microcosmography" by John Earle is a collection of essays and character sketches written in the early 17th century. This work offers a keen observation of human nature, exploring various types of individuals and their societal roles through a series of witty and insightful portraits.
